document.abstract: A brief description is provided for the more important technical activities, including work in progress on composite photography, lighting equipment, wind machines, strippable adhesives, transportation equipment, plastics, diffusion cloths and other items of interest in the production of motion pictures. Mention is also made of the Research Council's function in connection with new products, inventions, television, stereoscopic motion pictures, standards and test films.
